decisions.source: Codex Design native and web presentation modules
decisions.reason: One shared design owner with format-specific execution; old skill and knowledge files retired.

Reuse actual template authoring, SVG/native conversion, source-preserving edits, table/chart, asset and local-review implementations. Adapt paths, configuration, integrity, style fidelity and host lifecycle.

decisions.source: PPT Master icons and chart/table/layout/style resources
decisions.reason: Keep the indexed icon collection and notices intact; select neutral reusable layout/style families and visual primitives. No branded finished decks or stock sound collection.
Ten optional theme references, preserving license and original source hashes.
Local source license restricts copying and derivatives; adopted MIT implementation supplies the required native functions.
Asset preparation and cover/preview judgment are already covered; no independent presentation engine or duplicate design owner added.
Shared or brand-specific support, not a presentation default. Other media retain their own shared support.

decisions.source: Google Slides automation and remote image services
decisions.reason: Connected services require their own available tools/credentials. Local templates have no remote service prerequisite.

decisions.source: Donor updater, Git pin validation, external engine config and standalone donor skill
decisions.reason: Internal package identity, provenance and integrity replace donor distribution identity and checkout requirements.

compatibility: Root scripts/design_brain_pptx*.py, presentation_route.py and web-deck commands delegate to this capability for existing host callers. They contain no second implementation. Historical reports and schema identifiers remain as provenance/format compatibility.
generalOwners: Brain routing, cognition, simulation, generic craft and completion infrastructure remain shared plugin services. Presentation-specific workflow and runtime have one owner.
